tool.series: TOP-Cut VAR 4 flutes, square end, variable helix, chamfer (CH x 45 deg), center cutting

material.vendor_label: M 1.1 Stainless steel materials - Ferritic, martensitic (410 / 440 / 440C / 17-4 PH); <= 29 HRC, <= 280 HBN, <= 950 N/mm2

vendor_notes: Cutting data are given as vc [sfm] and fz [inch] = factor x d1 (feed per tooth proportional to cutting diameter d1).
RPM = (SFM x 3.82) / Dia. (in); Feed (IPM) = RPM x fz x Z; Z = number of teeth (flutes)
Metal Removal Rate (in3/min) = IPM x ae x ap
Icons on the page rate each material group as 'very suitable' or 'suitable' and give coolant suitability (dry, emulsion, MQL/MMS, internal coolant); see page.
Hardness-range limits and material examples are in the 'Applications / Materials' table on brochure page 4.
rows.notes: Read from the TOP-Cut VAR brochure (PDF page 26, printed page 26); vc and fz are the printed values for material group M 1.1 in the 'ae = d1 (slot)' column; fz (inch) = printed factor x d1 = 0.003 x 0.06250 in. Tool geometry from the product table on brochure page 8: 2992L.00625 (l1 1.5000 in, l2 0.1250 in, shank 0.1250 in, chamfer 0.002 in). Group M 1.1 names 17-4 PH explicitly (together with 410/440/440C), so it is mapped to the PH family; the group hardness limit is <= 29 HRC (<= 280 HBN, <= 950 N/mm2), i.e. not aged-hard 17-4. Helix: the brochure prints 35-38 deg (variable helix angle flutes); helix_deg is the midpoint of the printed range. No neck diameter or reach is published for this series (long and extra long versions are long-flute tools); neck_diameter and LB are null. Slot (ae = d1), ap = d1. Checked against rendered PDF page 26 (110 dpi image): column and row mapping confirmed. The fz factor is printed to 3 decimals (resolution about 0.0005 x d1), so the computed inch fz carries that rounding.

rows.notes: Read from the TOP-Cut VAR brochure (PDF page 26, printed page 26); vc and fz are the printed values for material group M 1.1 in the 'ae = 0.2 x d1' column; fz (inch) = printed factor x d1 = 0.004 x 0.25000 in. Tool geometry from the product table on brochure page 8: 2992L.0250 (l1 2.0000 in, l2 0.5000 in, shank 0.2500 in, chamfer 0.005 in). Group M 1.1 names 17-4 PH explicitly (together with 410/440/440C), so it is mapped to the PH family; the group hardness limit is <= 29 HRC (<= 280 HBN, <= 950 N/mm2), i.e. not aged-hard 17-4. Helix: the brochure prints 35-38 deg (variable helix angle flutes); helix_deg is the midpoint of the printed range. The fz factor is printed to 3 decimals (resolution about 0.0005 x d1), so the computed inch fz carries that rounding.

Helix is printed as 38-42 deg (variable); helix_deg is the midpoint. Group M 1.1 names 17-4 PH explicitly (together with 410/440/440C), so it is mapped to the PH family; the group hardness limit is <= 29 HRC (<= 280 HBN, <= 950 N/mm2), i.e. not aged-hard 17-4.
